TEAR-STRIKE_TEAR.title: Strike
TEAR-NOCTURNAL_LIGHT.title: Nocturnal Light
TEAR-POW_HAMMER.title: Pow Hammer
TEAR-DEFEND_TEAR.title: Defend
TEAR-NIGHTMARE.title: Nightmare
TEAR-HIDDEN_KNIFE.title: Hidden Knife
TEAR-MAGIC_ATTACK.title: Magic Attack
TEAR-HEAVY_SWING.title: Heavy Swing
TEAR-HEAVY_SWING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Gain {WindFonon}. 
The next Attack you play costs 0 {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TEAR-DAGGER_THROW.title: Dagger Throw
TEAR-DAGGER_THROW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TEAR-FINALE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} if you played a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] card this turn.
TEAR-FINALE.title: Finale
TEAR-TRAINED_ASSASSIN.title: Trained Assassin
TEAR-TRAINED_ASSASSIN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
If this is the first card you play this turn, play a random Attack from your hand.
TEAR-INVOKE_FIRE.title: Invoke Flame
TEAR-INVOKE_WATER.title: Invoke Aqua
TEAR-INVOKE_EARTH.title: Invoke Ground
TEAR-INVOKE_WIND.title: Invoke Gale
TEAR-INVOKE_DARK.title: Invoke Darkness
TEAR-INVOKE_LIGHT.title: Invoke Light
TEAR-DOUBT.title: Doubt
TEAR-ELEGANCE.title: Elegance
TEAR-ENHANCE_CAST.title: Enhance Cast
TEAR-ENHANCE_CAST.description:
The next Attack you play costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. 
{WindFonon}: The next Skill you play costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
TEAR-CHARGE.title: Charge
TEAR-FORCE_FIELD.title: Force Field
TEAR-FIRST_AID.title: First Aid
TEAR-FIRST_AID.description:
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP. 
{WaterFonon}: Double the healing. 
Cannot heal above the HP you had at the start of combat.
TEAR-HEALING_CIRCLE.title: Healing Circle
TEAR-HEALING_CIRCLE.description:
Exhaust up to {Cards:diff()} cards. 
Recover {Heal:diff()} HP for each card Exhausted. 
You can only heal up to your starting combat HP. 
{WindFonon}: Double the healing.
TEAR-HEALING_CIRCLE.selectionScreenPromp: Choose up to 3 cards to Exhaust.
TEAR-RESURRECTION.title: Resurrection
TEAR-RESURRECTION.description:
Recover {Heal:diff()} HP. 
Gain [gold]Resurrection[/gold]. 
Gain {LightFonon}. 
{WaterFonon}: Costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and applies [gold]Resurrection[/gold] to ALL allies.
TEAR-ENCORE.title: Encore
TEAR-ENCORE.description: Play a random [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] from your discard pile and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
TEAR-RECOMPOSE.title: Recompose
TEAR-RECOMPOSE.description:
Exhaust 1 card in your hand. 
Add a random [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] to your hand. It gains [gold]Retain[/gold].
TEAR-REVITALISE.title: Revitalise
TEAR-REVITALISE.description:
Recover {Heal:diff()}% of your missing HP relative to your starting combat HP. 
Gain {WaterFonon}.
TEAR-CAST_ARTE.title: Cast Arte
TEAR-CAST_ARTE.description:
Add a random [gold]Arte[/gold] to your hand. 
It is free to play this turn.
TEAR-HOLY_SONG.title: Holy Song
TEAR-LUCKY_MAGIC.title: Lucky Magic
TEAR-LUCKY_MAGIC.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} card. 
If the drawn card is an [gold]Arte[/gold], it is free to play this turn.
TEAR-FREE_RUN.title: Free Run
TEAR-FREE_RUN.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
Draw cards until you draw an Attack.
TEAR-MAGIC_GUARD.title: Magic Guard
TEAR-MAGIC_GUARD.description:
Discard 1 card. 
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
If the discarded card is an [gold]Arte[/gold], gain [gold]Block[/gold] another time.
TEAR-POWER_CHARGE.title: Power Charge
TEAR-POWER_CHARGE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
Upgrade all [gold]Artes[/gold] in your hand.
TEAR-GUARD_PLUS.title: Guard Plus
TEAR-BACKSTEP.title: Backstep
TEAR-SPEED_CAST.title: Speed Cast
TEAR-SPEED_CAST.description:
All cards in your hand are free to play this turn. 
You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] this turn.
TEAR-DASH.title: Dash
TEAR-NULLIFY.title: Nullify
TEAR-LONG_STEP.title: Long Step
TEAR-LONG_STEP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
Costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} if you've played an [gold]Arte[/gold] this turn.
TEAR-RHYTHM.title: Rhythm
TEAR-RHYTHM.description: Play the top {Cards:diff()} cards of your draw pile.
TEAR-SPELL_SAVE.title: Spell Save
TEAR-SPELL_SAVE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
Retain your hand this turn.
TEAR-REPRISE.title: Reprise
TEAR-REPRISE.description: Your next [gold]Arte[/gold] or [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] is played twice.
TEAR-BACK_ACTION.title: Back Action
TEAR-BACK_ACTION.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
If this is the first card you play this turn, your next Attack costs 0 {Energy:energyIcons()}.
TEAR-FONIC_BARRIER.title: Fonic Barrier
TEAR-FONIC_BARRIER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. 
For 1 turn, reflect all blocked damage to the attacker.
TEAR-CRESCENDO.title: Crescendo
TEAR-CADENCE.title: Cadence
TEAR-CADENCE.description: This turn and next turn, you can play more than 1 [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] per turn.
TEAR-SEVENTH_FONIST.title: Seventh Fonist
TEAR-SEVENTH_FONIST.description: At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Arte[/gold] to your hand. It gains [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
TEAR-STRONG_OF_HEART.title: Strong of Heart
TEAR-STRONG_OF_HEART.description: The first time you play a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] each turn, gain 1 Energy.
TEAR-YULIAS_BLESSING.title: Yulia's Blessing
TEAR-YULIAS_BLESSING.description: Whenever you gain an elemental [gold]Fonon[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
TEAR-RESOLUTE_MELODY.title: Resolute Melody
TEAR-RESOLUTE_MELODY.description: Whenever you gain an elemental [gold]Fonon[/gold], gain 3 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
TEAR-YULIAS_DESCENDANT.title: Yulia's Descendant
TEAR-YULIAS_DESCENDANT.description:
[gold]Fonic Hymns[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold]. 
At the start of your turn, gain {Overlimit:diff()} [gold]Over Limit[/gold].
TEAR-LINGERING_MELODY.title: Lingering Melody
TEAR-LINGERING_MELODY.description: At the end of your turn, if you did not play a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold], play and Exhaust a random [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold].
TEAR-FONON_ABSORPTION.title: Fonon Absorption
TEAR-FONON_ABSORPTION.description:
At the start of your turn, if you do not have an elemental [gold]Fonon[/gold], gain either {LightFonon} or {DarkFonon}. 
Whenever you play an [gold]Arte[/gold], gain {Overlimit:diff()} additional [gold]Over Limit[/gold].
TEAR-SACRED_RESONANCE.title: Sacred Resonance
TEAR-FIFTH_HARMONY.title: Fifth Harmony
TEAR-FIFTH_HARMONY.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold], draw 1 card.
TEAR-PITCH_PERFECT.title: Pitch Perfect
TEAR-PITCH_PERFECT.description: The first {Amount:diff()} {Amount:plural:card|cards} you play each turn {Amount:plural:is|are} free.
TEAR-GRAND_MAESTRO.title: Grand Maestro
TEAR-GRAND_MAESTRO.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
TEAR-COMBAT_EXPERT.title: Combat Expert
TEAR-FLOWER_OF_THE_QLIPHOTH.title: Flower of the Qliphoth
TEAR-FLOWER_OF_THE_QLIPHOTH.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
TEAR-FONIC_MASTERY.title: Fonic Mastery
TEAR-SEVERED_FATE.title: Severed Fate
TEAR-HOLY_LANCE.title: Holy Lance
TEAR-HOLY_LANCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times to ALL enemies. 
{EarthFonon}: X is doubled.
TEAR-INNOCENT_SHINE.title: Innocent Shine
TEAR-INNOCENT_SHINE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Damage increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for every [gold]Arte[/gold] you've played this combat.
TEAR-NOCTURNAL_AQUA.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
If there is only 1 enemy, deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
TEAR-NOCTURNAL_AQUA.title: Nocturnal Aqua
TEAR-BANISHING_SORROW.title: Banishing Sorrow
TEAR-BANISHING_SORROW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold]. 
{FireFonon}: Targets ALL enemies.
TEAR-ECLAIR_DE_LARMES.title: Éclair de Larmes
TEAR-ECLAIR_DE_LARMES.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
{FireFonon}: Double the effectiveness of [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] for {Turns:diff()} turns.
TEAR-RESOLUTE_ELEGY.title: Resolute Elegy
TEAR-RESOLUTE_ELEGY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies. 
Gain {DarkFonon}.
TEAR-CANDLE_SUPPLY.title: Candle Supply
TEAR-CANDLE_SUPPLY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. 
Costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} less for each Skill you've played this turn. 
Gain {FireFonon}.
TEAR-RINENUTO_FUGUE.title: Ritenuto Fugue
TEAR-HARMONISE_SCORE.title: Harmonise Score
TEAR-HARMONISE_SCORE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Hit an additional time for each [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] card you have.
TEAR-FORTUNES_ARC.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Damage increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} for every [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] you've played this combat.
TEAR-FORTUNES_ARC.title: Fortune's Arc
TEAR-MYSTIC_ARTE.title: Mystic Arte
TEAR-MYSTIC_ARTE.description:
Play [gold]Innocent Shine[/gold]. 
If you've played a [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold] this turn, you may choose to play [gold]Fortune's Arc[/gold] instead.
TEAR-MYXOLIDIA_OF_FONONS.title: Myxolidia of Fonons
TEAR-MYXOLIDIA_OF_FONONS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies. 
Gain {DarkFonon}.
TEAR-JUDGMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitCount} times to a random enemy. 
Gain {FireFonon}.
TEAR-JUDGMENT.title: Judgment
TEAR-SEVENTH_LIGHT.title: Seventh Light
TEAR-SEVENTH_LIGHT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {HitCount} times to ALL enemies. 
{WindFonon}: Hit 3 additional times.
TEAR-GRAND_CROSS.title: Grand Cross
TEAR-GRAND_CROSS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. 
Gain {LightFonon}.
